residue_special_token_handling: remove BOS and EOS; retain one row per input residue
dna_representation: learned nucleotide projection with seven position embeddings
candidate_rc_pooling: arithmetic mean of oriented sequence and reverse complement scores
target_window_rc_pooling: arithmetic mean of each target window and its reverse complement
target_window_pooling: arithmetic mean across canonical reverse-complement target windows
interaction: single scaled dot-product residue attention followed by small comparative MLP
pair_sampling: reuse frozen v0.5 protocol: 512 pairs/protein, 40% easy, 35% medium, 25% hard
